sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: CAA/EAA artwork icons no longer blank out and repaint on every sort or filter keystroke on multi-table page types (artist-releasegroups, releasegroup-releases, artist-relationships, …). Rows re-inserted by a re-render now arrive with their thumbnails already in place.

Technical: on multi-table pages renderGroupedTable() always inserts clones, so artwork was painted onto the rendered clone while the source rows in groupedRows stayed blank — which made _stripTransientCellState()'s existing preserveLiveArt option a no-op on that path, since there was never anything on a clone to preserve. A new _artMirrorIconToSourceRow() mirrors a painted icon's background-image back onto the matching source row (same write-back shape as _artSyncSearchTextToSourceRow()), and the multi clone loop now opts into preserveLiveArt. Measured on a 17-sub-table artist-releasegroups page: icons already painted at row insertion went from 0 of 123 to 85 of 123 — every icon that had artwork.

The source-row lookup uses _findMasterRowByIdx() rather than the group-index lookup its sibling uses. Merged discography view combines several groups' rows into the first-occurrence table, so an index-based lookup silently misses exactly those rows and would drop their artwork.

Not changed: inline thumbnails are still rebuilt on a re-render (their placeholder is injected into live rows only, so a source row has no counterpart to mirror onto), and sorting one sub-table still re-renders all of them. Neither issues any network request — both repaint from the in-session memory cache.
